newsitem.title: PERU: Peru says Jan oil output rises 1.8 pct vs yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Peru says Jan oil output rises 1.8 pct vs yr ago.

text.p: Peru produced an average of 117,680 barrels per day (bpd) of crude oil in January, up 1.8 percent from 115,647 bpd in the same month last year, said Energy and Mines Ministry.
Total oil production in January was 3.65 million barrels, up from 3.58 million in the same month last year, the ministry added in its monthly report.
Natural gas output in January averaged 22.59 million cubic feet per day, down from 24.42 million in January last year.
Total oil production in Peru dropped 2.9 percent in 1996 to an average of 118,270 bpd of crude.
U.S.-based firms Occidental Petroleum Corp, Petro- Tech S.A., Argentina's Pluspetrol and state oil company Petroperu S.A. account for more than 90 percent of Peru's total oil output.
